requirements.requirement: Shelf unit for books (flat shelving surface to display/store books)
requirements.evidence: Two-storey hex base structure with level-1 flat top deck (covers cover:-1,0,1;full;top + cover:0,0,1;full;top + cover:0,1,1;full;top + cover:1,0,1;full;top) forming approx 453x310 mm continuous top (surface f21) dressed with book-row prop; structure is capped and joint-bolted (meshClash clear).

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks fit/collision only and parts are user-printed plastic. No load, strength, material or engineering verification is performed here. Shape provides a flat shelf for light display books (as shown), but 50 kg rating cannot be met, claimed or tested in this system; requires independent structural engineering and material choice.
Two cut-face drawers installed on half-s bases: drawer:0#-1,-1#cut at piece:-1,-1,0;half-s and drawer:0#0,-1#cut at piece:0,-1,0;half-s, both with interior compartments (surfaces f6-f20).

finish.summary: Built a compact two-level shelf unit with a continuous top deck for books and two front-facing drawers. Dressed with a row of books to show use, capped and joint-bolted with clear mesh check. The 50 kg load rating cannot be provided by this 3D-printed configurator – the build is a form/staging model only and would require separate engineering, material selection and testing for any load claim.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
